statements.proposition: This change maintains backward compatibility: default behaviour (with default configuration) is unchanged.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The PR's justification is that EnforceOrgQuotas defaults to true, but at base config.Default does not set EnforceOrgQuotas (Go zero value false) and the field has no default tag; tyk.conf.example does not set enforce_org_quotas. So with default config in RPC storage mode, EnforceOrgDataAge was forced true before and is no longer forced after this change: default behaviour changes. Medium because real deployments may set the flag explicitly.
evidence: gh api pulls/7447/files: gateway/api_loader.go replaces unconditional spec.GlobalConfig.EnforceOrgDataAge = true / globalConf.EnforceOrgDataAge = true with gw.enforceOrgDataAgeIfQuotasEnabled(spec), which returns early if !globalConf.EnforceOrgQuotas
config/config.go at base 1d0d584: `Default = Config{...}` block has no EnforceOrgQuotas entry; field declared `EnforceOrgQuotas bool `json:"enforce_org_quotas"`` (no default)
grep enforce_org in tyk.conf.example at base: no match
